scope: Authored Traditional Chinese / English engineering learning units; public principles, not proprietary recipes.

courses.title: 薄膜鈮酸鋰異質整合
courses.summary: 從晶軸、電光重疊與異質界面拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate crystal orientation, electro-optic overlap and heterogeneous interfaces, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 教學假設 VπL=2 V·cm，L=5 mm=0.5 cm，則 Vπ=4 V；改為 2.5 mm 得 8 V。這只比較相移效率，沒有估算終端或射頻損失。
workedExample.textEn: Assume VπL=2 V·cm and L=5 mm=0.5 cm, giving Vπ=4 V; 2.5 mm gives 8 V. This compares phase efficiency without termination or RF loss.
workedExample.assumptions: 電極定義、偏振及波長固定；不能把教學 VπL 視為商用品規格。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Fix electrode definition, polarization and wavelength; the teaching VπL is not a commercial specification.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

stages.title: 材料與模式
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「材料與模式」的模型與驗證，六項作業各自留存交付物。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units address Materials and modes through six separately saved modeling and verification work packages.

steps.title: 晶軸與偏振：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Crystal axes and polarization: model and design
steps.objective: 以「晶軸與偏振」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for crystal axes and polarization, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「晶軸與偏振」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。鈮酸鋰的電光響應是張量；晶切面、光偏振與電場方向共同決定有效係數。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for crystal axes and polarization, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Lithium niobate has a tensor electro-optic response; cut, optical polarization and field direction determine the effective coefficient. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。
steps.observationEn: Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：鈮酸鋰每個晶向有相同電光係數。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Lithium niobate has the same electro-optic coefficient in every direction. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交晶軸與偏振的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for crystal axes and polarization, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component.

steps.check: 提交晶軸與偏振的量測判別表：旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for crystal axes and polarization: Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

options: 異質材料熱膨脹失配能使薄膜彎曲並改變光耦合。
鈮酸鋰每個晶向有相同電光係數。
只要增加電極長度就必定提高頻寬。
optionsEn: Thermal-expansion mismatch can bend the heterogeneous film and alter optical coupling.
Lithium niobate has the same electro-optic coefficient in every direction.
Increasing electrode length always increases bandwidth.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Fix power reference planes and add passive losses in dB; feedback and nonlinear self-heating are excluded.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate donor coupons, stamp transfer and heterogeneous optical coupling, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設釋放、拾取、放置與連接成功率依序為 0.98、0.99、0.97、0.99，獨立模型總良率=0.9317，即約 93.2%；1000 顆的期望成功數約 932，非保證實得數。
workedExample.textEn: Assume independent release, pickup, placement and connection probabilities of 0.98, 0.99, 0.97 and 0.99. Total yield is 0.9317, about 93.2%; 1,000 coupons give about 932 expected successes, not a guaranteed count.
workedExample.assumptions: 獨立良率模型不含同批污染、印章磨耗與空間相關性。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: The independent-yield model excludes batch contamination, stamp wear and spatial correlation.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「供體晶粒邊界」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。可轉印晶粒需在源晶圓上保留支撐與釋放路徑；元件良率和釋放良率分開計算。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「畫出元件、錨點與犧牲層的概念截面，標明哪個測試在釋放前完成。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for donor-coupon boundary, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Printable coupons need support and release paths on the donor; device and release yields are separate. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Draw conceptual device, tether and release-layer sections and mark tests completed before release. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 畫出元件、錨點與犧牲層的概念截面，標明哪個測試在釋放前完成。

steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：單一最佳晶粒可以代表整片陣列良率。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

steps.check: 提交供體晶粒邊界的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「畫出元件、錨點與犧牲層的概念截面，標明哪個測試在釋放前完成。」反駁模型的預測。

steps.objective: 以「電接觸連續性」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for electrical contact continuity, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。將四線電阻與 L-I-V 量測對照，分離接觸與主動區變化。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「光對準成功不保證電連接；接觸電阻會增加自熱與電壓降。」與錯誤假說「總良率等於各步良率的算術平均。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Correlate four-wire resistance with L-I-V measurements to separate contacts from active-region changes. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Successful optical alignment does not guarantee electrical continuity; contact resistance adds heat and voltage drop." against the incorrect hypothesis "Total yield is the arithmetic average of step yields."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 將四線電阻與 L-I-V 量測對照，分離接觸與主動區變化。
steps.observationEn: Correlate four-wire resistance with L-I-V measurements to separate contacts from active-region changes.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：總良率等於各步良率的算術平均。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Total yield is the arithmetic average of step yields. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交電接觸連續性的量測判別表：將四線電阻與 L-I-V 量測對照，分離接觸與主動區變化。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for electrical contact continuity: Correlate four-wire resistance with L-I-V measurements to separate contacts from active-region changes. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

knowledge.title: 本單元物理機制
knowledge.text: 光對準成功不保證電連接；接觸電阻會增加自熱與電壓降。
knowledge.textEn: Successful optical alignment does not guarantee electrical continuity; contact resistance adds heat and voltage drop.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與證據
knowledge.text: 將四線電阻與 L-I-V 量測對照，分離接觸與主動區變化。
knowledge.textEn: Correlate four-wire resistance with L-I-V measurements to separate contacts from active-region changes.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: Ytotal=∏Yi；對位殘差須在共同坐標下計算。 獨立良率模型不含同批污染、印章磨耗與空間相關性。
knowledge.textEn: Ytotal=∏Yi; alignment residuals must use a common coordinate system. The independent-yield model excludes batch contamination, stamp wear and spatial correlation.

quiz.question: 要審查「電接觸連續性」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing electrical contact continuity?
options: 將四線電阻與 L-I-V 量測對照，分離接觸與主動區變化。
總良率等於各步良率的算術平均。
單一最佳晶粒可以代表整片陣列良率。
optionsEn: Correlate four-wire resistance with L-I-V measurements to separate contacts from active-region changes.
Total yield is the arithmetic average of step yields.
The best coupon represents full-array yield.
quiz.explanation: 光對準成功不保證電連接；接觸電阻會增加自熱與電壓降。 將四線電阻與 L-I-V 量測對照，分離接觸與主動區變化。
quiz.explanationEn: Successful optical alignment does not guarantee electrical continuity; contact resistance adds heat and voltage drop. Correlate four-wire resistance with L-I-V measurements to separate contacts from active-region changes.

steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for coupon thermal path, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Thin coupons and bond interfaces localize heat paths; mean substrate temperature can hide hot spots. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Compare spectral drift and transient thermal response at different drive duty cycles. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.

steps.check: 提交晶粒熱路的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「比較不同驅動占空比的光譜漂移與暫態熱響應。」反駁模型的預測。

courses.title: 矽上量子點雷射研究
courses.summary: 從量子點增益、異質磊晶缺陷與長期穩定性拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate quantum-dot gain, heteroepitaxial defects and long-term stability, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設閾值電流 30 mA，注入面積 3 μm×1000 μm=3×10^-5 cm²，Jth=1000 A/cm²。若誤以 6 μm 寬換算，會得 500 A/cm²；差別來自定義，並非元件改進。
workedExample.textEn: Assume threshold current 30 mA and injection area 3 μm×1000 μm=3×10^-5 cm², giving Jth=1000 A/cm². Using 6 μm width instead gives 500 A/cm²; that difference is a definition error, not device improvement.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例不表示任何原始論文性能；面積定義與儀器校正需一致。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: The example does not represent any cited paper performance; area definition and calibration must be consistent.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: 外接光源光引擎
courses.summary: 從外接連續光源、光分配與可維修性拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate external CW sources, optical distribution and serviceability, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設光源 40 mW 經 1:4 分光，另有 1 dB 超額損失及 2 dB 連接損失；每路=40/4×10^(-3/10)=5.01 mW。四路功率總和約 20.0 mW，其餘為損失。
workedExample.textEn: Assume a 40 mW source, 1:4 splitting, 1 dB excess loss and 2 dB connection loss. Each branch receives 40/4×10^(-3/10)=5.01 mW; all four total about 20.0 mW, with the remainder lost.
workedExample.assumptions: 假設等分、穩態和無增益；沒有把此功率宣稱安全或符合任何雷射等級。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Assume equal splitting, steady state and no gain; this power is not claimed safe or compliant with a laser class.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for redundant sources, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Two sources sharing power, connectors or cooling retain common-cause failures. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Draw minimal cut sets separating lasers, power and shared-fiber failure domains. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 畫最小割集，分開雷射、供電與共用光纖的失效域。
steps.observationEn: Draw minimal cut sets separating lasers, power and shared-fiber failure domains.

steps.check: 提交冗餘光源的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「畫最小割集，分開雷射、供電與共用光纖的失效域。」反駁模型的預測。

courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate gain compression, spontaneous emission and optoelectrothermal interfaces, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設輸入 0.1 mW、SOA 小訊號增益 15 dB、後段損失 3 dB，線性估計輸出=0.1×10^(12/10)=1.585 mW；若已達飽和，此估計須下修。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 0.1 mW input, 15 dB small-signal gain and 3 dB downstream loss. Linear output is 0.1×10^(12/10)=1.585 mW; saturation invalidates this extrapolation.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Saturation, polarization and temperature changes are excluded; total optical power is not signal power.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: 波分多工陣列波導光柵
courses.summary: 從陣列光程差、成像與通道串擾拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate array path differences, imaging and channel crosstalk, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 ng=4、相鄰臂長差 ΔL=50 μm，FSRν≈c/(ngΔL)=1.50 THz；在 λ=1550 nm 附近，FSRλ≈λ²/(ngΔL)=12.0 nm。 此算例以 c=3.00×10^8 m/s 作教學近似。
workedExample.textEn: Assume ng=4 and adjacent-arm increment ΔL=50 μm. FSRν≈c/(ngΔL)=1.50 THz; near λ=1550 nm, FSRλ≈λ²/(ngΔL)=12.0 nm. This example uses the teaching approximation c=3.00×10^8 m/s.
workedExample.assumptions: 小波長範圍近似且忽略高階色散；不代表任何量產 AWG 尺寸。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Local-wavelength approximation neglecting higher dispersion; not a production AWG dimension.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

stages.title: 規格與相位
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「規格與相位」的模型與驗證，六項作業各自留存交付物。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units address Requirements and phase through six separately saved modeling and verification work packages.

steps.title: 頻率與波長格點：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Frequency and wavelength grids: model and design
steps.objective: 以「頻率與波長格點」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for frequency and wavelength grids, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「頻率與波長格點」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。等頻率間隔並非嚴格等波長間隔，換算需指定中心波長。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「將三個等頻率通道換為波長，檢查是否錯用固定 nm 間距。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for frequency and wavelength grids, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Equal frequency spacing is not exactly equal wavelength spacing; conversion needs a center wavelength. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Convert three equally spaced frequencies to wavelengths and check misuse of fixed nm spacing. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 將三個等頻率通道換為波長，檢查是否錯用固定 nm 間距。
steps.observationEn: Convert three equally spaced frequencies to wavelengths and check misuse of fixed nm spacing.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：相位折射率一定可直接代替群折射率。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Phase index always directly replaces group index. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交頻率與波長格點的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「將三個等頻率通道換為波長，檢查是否錯用固定 nm 間距。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for frequency and wavelength grids, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Convert three equally spaced frequencies to wavelengths and check misuse of fixed nm spacing.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: Δφ=2πneffΔL/λ；FSR 使用群折射率。 小波長範圍近似且忽略高階色散；不代表任何量產 AWG 尺寸。
knowledge.textEn: Δφ=2πneffΔL/λ; FSR uses group index. Local-wavelength approximation neglecting higher dispersion; not a production AWG dimension.

quiz.question: 要審查「頻率與波長格點」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing frequency and wavelength grids?
options: 等頻率間隔並非嚴格等波長間隔，換算需指定中心波長。
相位折射率一定可直接代替群折射率。
光纖到光纖損失全部來自 AWG 核心。
optionsEn: Equal frequency spacing is not exactly equal wavelength spacing; conversion needs a center wavelength.
Phase index always directly replaces group index.
All fiber-to-fiber loss comes from the AWG core.

quiz.explanationEn: Equal frequency spacing is not exactly equal wavelength spacing; conversion needs a center wavelength. Convert three equally spaced frequencies to wavelengths and check misuse of fixed nm spacing.

steps.title: 頻率與波長格點：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Frequency and wavelength grids: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「頻率與波長格點」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for frequency and wavelength grids, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。將三個等頻率通道換為波長，檢查是否錯用固定 nm 間距。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「等頻率間隔並非嚴格等波長間隔，換算需指定中心波長。」與錯誤假說「光纖到光纖損失全部來自 AWG 核心。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Convert three equally spaced frequencies to wavelengths and check misuse of fixed nm spacing. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Equal frequency spacing is not exactly equal wavelength spacing; conversion needs a center wavelength." against the incorrect hypothesis "All fiber-to-fiber loss comes from the AWG core."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.

steps.observationEn: Convert three equally spaced frequencies to wavelengths and check misuse of fixed nm spacing.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：光纖到光纖損失全部來自 AWG 核心。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: All fiber-to-fiber loss comes from the AWG core. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交頻率與波長格點的量測判別表：將三個等頻率通道換為波長，檢查是否錯用固定 nm 間距。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for frequency and wavelength grids: Convert three equally spaced frequencies to wavelengths and check misuse of fixed nm spacing. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

courses.title: 微環波分多工濾波器
courses.summary: 從環腔共振、通道格點與熱鎖定拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate ring resonances, channel grids and thermal locking, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 λ0=1550 nm、載入 Q=10000，線寬 Δλ=0.155 nm=155 pm；Δf≈cΔλ/λ²≈19.35 GHz。這不是某調變格式的自動合格門檻。 此算例以 c=3.00×10^8 m/s 作教學近似。
workedExample.textEn: Assume λ0=1550 nm and loaded Q=10000. Linewidth is 0.155 nm=155 pm, or Δf≈cΔλ/λ²≈19.35 GHz. This is not an automatic pass limit for a modulation format. This example uses the teaching approximation c=3.00×10^8 m/s.
workedExample.assumptions: 孤立共振、小範圍線性近似；濾波線形及訊號品質仍須量測。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Isolated-resonance, local-linear approximation; lineshape and signal quality still require measurement.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: 光子晶片光開關矩陣
courses.summary: 從開關拓撲、損失串接與可觀測性拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate switch topology, cascaded loss and observability, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設一路經 6 個開關各 0.4 dB、4 個交叉各 0.05 dB、波導共 0.6 dB，總損失=3.2 dB；1 mW 輸入輸出約 0.479 mW。
workedExample.textEn: Assume six switches at 0.4 dB each, four crossings at 0.05 dB each and 0.6 dB routing loss. Total loss is 3.2 dB; 1 mW input gives about 0.479 mW.
workedExample.assumptions: 假設被動損失、無相干反射與增益；數字是教學工作負載。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Assume passive loss without coherent reflections or gain; values describe a teaching workload.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: 可程式化光子電路
courses.summary: 從可調干涉單元、矩陣分解與閉迴路校正拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate tunable interferometers, matrix decomposition and closed-loop calibration, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 8 級單元各有 0.25 dB 損失，總損失 2 dB，輸出功率比例 10^(-2/10)=0.631；因此理想酉矩陣的功率守恆不能直接用於此實體網格。
workedExample.textEn: Assume eight stages each lose 0.25 dB. Total loss is 2 dB and transmitted power fraction is 10^(-2/10)=0.631; ideal unitary power conservation cannot be directly assigned to this physical mesh.
workedExample.assumptions: 矩陣模型限於線性相干操作；非線性與動態熱記憶需擴充。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: The matrix model assumes linear coherent operation; nonlinearity and dynamic thermal memory require extensions.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

stages.title: 網格與模型
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「網格與模型」的模型與驗證，六項作業各自留存交付物。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units address Mesh and model through six separately saved modeling and verification work packages.

steps.title: 複數場表示：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「複數場表示」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for complex-field representation, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「複數場表示」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。光子線性網路作用於複數場，功率只保留振幅平方而失去相位。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「比較等功率、不同相位的兩組輸入干涉結果。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for complex-field representation, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Linear photonic networks act on complex fields; power retains squared amplitude but loses phase. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Compare interference for two inputs with equal powers but different phases. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 比較等功率、不同相位的兩組輸入干涉結果。
steps.observationEn: Compare interference for two inputs with equal powers but different phases.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：只量一個輸出功率就能重建所有複數相位。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: One output power reconstructs every complex phase. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交複數場表示的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「比較等功率、不同相位的兩組輸入干涉結果。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for complex-field representation, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Compare interference for two inputs with equal powers but different phases.

knowledge.title: 本單元物理機制
knowledge.text: 光子線性網路作用於複數場，功率只保留振幅平方而失去相位。
knowledge.textEn: Linear photonic networks act on complex fields; power retains squared amplitude but loses phase.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與證據
knowledge.text: 比較等功率、不同相位的兩組輸入干涉結果。
knowledge.textEn: Compare interference for two inputs with equal powers but different phases.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: Eout=TEin；檢驗 T†T 是否接近所採無損模型，而非先假設等於 I。 矩陣模型限於線性相干操作；非線性與動態熱記憶需擴充。
knowledge.textEn: Eout=TEin; test whether T†T approaches the chosen lossless model rather than assuming I. The matrix model assumes linear coherent operation; nonlinearity and dynamic thermal memory require extensions.

quiz.question: 要審查「複數場表示」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing complex-field representation?
options: 光子線性網路作用於複數場，功率只保留振幅平方而失去相位。
只量一個輸出功率就能重建所有複數相位。
任何實體網格都完全無損且酉。
optionsEn: Linear photonic networks act on complex fields; power retains squared amplitude but loses phase.
One output power reconstructs every complex phase.
Every physical mesh is lossless and unitary.
quiz.explanation: 光子線性網路作用於複數場，功率只保留振幅平方而失去相位。 比較等功率、不同相位的兩組輸入干涉結果。
quiz.explanationEn: Linear photonic networks act on complex fields; power retains squared amplitude but loses phase. Compare interference for two inputs with equal powers but different phases.

steps.title: 複數場表示：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「複數場表示」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for complex-field representation, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。比較等功率、不同相位的兩組輸入干涉結果。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「光子線性網路作用於複數場，功率只保留振幅平方而失去相位。」與錯誤假說「任何實體網格都完全無損且酉。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Compare interference for two inputs with equal powers but different phases. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Linear photonic networks act on complex fields; power retains squared amplitude but loses phase." against the incorrect hypothesis "Every physical mesh is lossless and unitary."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 比較等功率、不同相位的兩組輸入干涉結果。
steps.observationEn: Compare interference for two inputs with equal powers but different phases.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：任何實體網格都完全無損且酉。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Every physical mesh is lossless and unitary. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交複數場表示的量測判別表：比較等功率、不同相位的兩組輸入干涉結果。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for complex-field representation: Compare interference for two inputs with equal powers but different phases. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

steps.title: 級聯矩陣：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「級聯矩陣」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for cascaded matrices, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「級聯矩陣」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。矩陣乘法順序對應光路次序，一般不可交換。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「用兩個不同 2×2 矩陣驗證 AB 與 BA，再依算例檢查損失。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。 假設 8 級單元各有 0.25 dB 損失，總損失 2 dB，輸出功率比例 10^(-2/10)=0.631；因此理想酉矩陣的功率守恆不能直接用於此實體網格。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for cascaded matrices, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Matrix multiplication order follows optical propagation and is generally noncommutative. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Compare AB and BA for two distinct 2×2 matrices, then check loss with the example. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances. Assume eight stages each lose 0.25 dB. Total loss is 2 dB and transmitted power fraction is 10^(-2/10)=0.631; ideal unitary power conservation cannot be directly assigned to this physical mesh.

steps.observationEn: Compare AB and BA for two distinct 2×2 matrices, then check loss with the example.

steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: A local optimum is necessarily global. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交級聯矩陣的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「用兩個不同 2×2 矩陣驗證 AB 與 BA，再依算例檢查損失。」反駁模型的預測。

knowledge.textEn: Eout=TEin; test whether T†T approaches the chosen lossless model rather than assuming I. The matrix model assumes linear coherent operation; nonlinearity and dynamic thermal memory require extensions.

quiz.question: 要審查「目標編譯」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing target compilation?
options: 只量一個輸出功率就能重建所有複數相位。
所需算子可能含非酉增益或衰減，不能直接假設無損網格都可實現。
局部極值一定是全域最優。
optionsEn: One output power reconstructs every complex phase.
A target operator may include nonunitary gain or attenuation and need not fit a lossless mesh.
A local optimum is necessarily global.
quiz.explanation: 所需算子可能含非酉增益或衰減，不能直接假設無損網格都可實現。 檢查目標的奇異值，再標示額外衰減或正規化需求。
quiz.explanationEn: A target operator may include nonunitary gain or attenuation and need not fit a lossless mesh. Inspect target singular values and mark required attenuation or normalization.

steps.title: 目標編譯：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「目標編譯」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for target compilation, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。檢查目標的奇異值，再標示額外衰減或正規化需求。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「所需算子可能含非酉增益或衰減，不能直接假設無損網格都可實現。」與錯誤假說「只量一個輸出功率就能重建所有複數相位。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Inspect target singular values and mark required attenuation or normalization. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "A target operator may include nonunitary gain or attenuation and need not fit a lossless mesh." against the incorrect hypothesis "One output power reconstructs every complex phase."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 檢查目標的奇異值，再標示額外衰減或正規化需求。
steps.observationEn: Inspect target singular values and mark required attenuation or normalization.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：只量一個輸出功率就能重建所有複數相位。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: One output power reconstructs every complex phase. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交目標編譯的量測判別表：檢查目標的奇異值，再標示額外衰減或正規化需求。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for target compilation: Inspect target singular values and mark required attenuation or normalization. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

stages.title: 雜訊與誤差

stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units address Noise and errors through six separately saved modeling and verification work packages.

steps.title: 相位規約：模型與設計

steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for phase convention, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. A common phase at a reference plane may not affect power tasks but matters for coherent composition. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Compare complex matrices under a fixed convention rather than treating irrelevant global phase as failure. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 在固定規約下比對複數矩陣，避免把可忽略全域相位當元件故障。
steps.observationEn: Compare complex matrices under a fixed convention rather than treating irrelevant global phase as failure.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：只量一個輸出功率就能重建所有複數相位。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: One output power reconstructs every complex phase. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交相位規約的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「在固定規約下比對複數矩陣，避免把可忽略全域相位當元件故障。」反駁模型的預測。

courses.title: 相干光接收器整合
courses.summary: 從光混頻、平衡偵測與光電共同設計拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate optical mixing, balanced detection and optoelectronic co-design, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設單一 50:50 平衡混頻器的入口功率（已扣除 I/Q 分支分光）為 Ps=0.01 mW、Plo=1 mW，響應度 R=0.8 A/W；差動拍頻峰值 i=2R√(PsPlo)=0.16 mA。Ps、Plo 並非整個 90° 混合器分光前的總功率。
workedExample.textEn: Assume inputs of one ideal 50:50 balanced mixer, after any I/Q branch splitting: Ps=0.01 mW, Plo=1 mW and responsivity R=0.8 A/W. Differential beat amplitude i=2R√(PsPlo)=0.16 mA. These are not total powers before a full 90-degree hybrid splits them.
workedExample.assumptions: 理想匹配、無飽和、未含散粒與 TIA 噪聲；非靈敏度保證。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Ideal matching without saturation, shot noise or TIA noise; not a sensitivity guarantee.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: 光子相位陣列
courses.summary: 從陣列相位、遠場旁瓣與封裝校正拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate array phase, far-field sidelobes and package calibration, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設均勻陣列 d=λ/2，欲偏轉 θ=30°，在所定符號下相鄰相位增量幅值 |Δφ|=2π(d/λ)sinθ=π/2；符號決定左右方向。
workedExample.textEn: Assume a uniform array with d=λ/2 and θ=30°. The adjacent phase-step magnitude is |Δφ|=2π(d/λ)sinθ=π/2; its sign sets left versus right under the chosen convention.
workedExample.assumptions: 均勻直線陣列、遠場、忽略互耦；不是眼安全或最大量距模型。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Uniform linear array in the far field, neglecting mutual coupling; not an eye-safety or maximum-range model.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

stages.title: 場與孔徑

steps.title: 陣列因子：模型與設計

quiz.question: 要審查「相位梯度」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？

options: 增天線數必定消除間距造成的光柵瓣。

steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Check radians and degrees in the example with a consistent phase/direction sign convention. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Adjacent phase gradient and spacing jointly set beam direction." against the incorrect hypothesis "Adding antennas always removes spacing-induced grating lobes."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model. steps.check: 提交相位梯度的量測判別表：按算例檢查弧度與角度，並保持相位與觀察方向符號規約一致。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。

courses.summary: 從線性啁啾、相干拍頻與距速分離拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate linear chirps, coherent beats and range-velocity separation, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 B=10 GHz、T=100 μs，斜率 S=10^14 Hz/s；靜止目標 R=15 m，fb=2SR/c≈10 MHz。理想解析度 c/(2B)=15 mm；不含窗函數及雜訊。 此算例以 c=3.00×10^8 m/s 作教學近似。
workedExample.textEn: Assume B=10 GHz and T=100 μs, giving S=10^14 Hz/s. A static target at R=15 m gives fb≈10 MHz. Ideal resolution c/(2B)=15 mm, excluding window and noise effects. This example uses the teaching approximation c=3.00×10^8 m/s.
workedExample.assumptions: 線性啁啾、單一靜止目標及校正時間基準；此課僅虛擬光路。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Linear chirp, one static target and calibrated timing; only a virtual optical path is used.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: 矽光子生物感測器
courses.summary: 從表面感測、參考通道與檢出限拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate surface sensing, reference channels and detection limits, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設濃度校正斜率 0.20 nm/(mg/L)，空白波長標準差 0.002 nm，以 3σ/slope 估計 LOD=0.030 mg/L。此為自訂統計示例，不是任何生物標記的診斷門檻。
workedExample.textEn: Assume calibration slope 0.20 nm/(mg/L) and blank wavelength SD 0.002 nm. A 3σ/slope estimate gives LOD=0.030 mg/L. This is a statistical teaching example, not a diagnostic cutoff for any biomarker.
workedExample.assumptions: 假設局部線性、穩定空白與指定噪聲統計；吸附飽和、基質效應不在算例內。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Assume local linearity, stable blanks and specified noise statistics; adsorption saturation and matrix effects are excluded.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: 中紅外積體光子感測
courses.summary: 從中紅外材料透明窗、吸收路徑與背景校正拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate mid-IR transparency windows, absorption paths and background calibration, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設吸收係數 α=2 cm^-1、模態重疊 Γ=0.10、長度 L=1 cm，僅樣本吸收時 T=exp(-ΓαL)=exp(-0.2)=0.819；十進吸光度=-log10 T=0.0869。
workedExample.textEn: Assume α=2 cm^-1, modal overlap Γ=0.10 and length L=1 cm. With sample absorption alone T=exp(-ΓαL)=0.819; base-10 absorbance is -log10 T=0.0869.
workedExample.assumptions: 均勻濃度、弱耦合擾動與線性吸收；不代表某化學物質實測值。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Uniform concentration, weak modal perturbation and linear absorption; not measured values for a chemical.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: 矽光子頻率梳
courses.summary: 從微腔色散、非線性振盪與頻梳相干性拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate microresonator dispersion, nonlinear oscillation and comb coherence, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設環半徑 R=100 μm、ng=2，腔長 L=2πR=628.3 μm，FSR=c/(ngL)≈238.7 GHz。這只估線性模態間隔，不能由此聲稱已形成孤子。 此算例以 c=3.00×10^8 m/s 作教學近似。
workedExample.textEn: Assume ring radius R=100 μm and ng=2. Length L=628.3 μm gives FSR≈238.7 GHz. This estimates linear mode spacing and does not establish soliton formation. This example uses the teaching approximation c=3.00×10^8 m/s.
workedExample.assumptions: 群折射率取常數的局部近似；泵浦、熱與非線性閾值不含於算例。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Local constant-group-index approximation; pump, thermal and nonlinear thresholds are excluded.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.summary: 從光子對、光譜純度與符合計數拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate photon pairs, spectral purity and coincidence counting, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設每秒產生 10^6 對，兩臂總效率皆 0.10，理想真符合率=10^6×0.1×0.1=10^4/s。若原始符合 11000/s、偶然 1000/s，raw CAR=11，net CAR=10；需注明慣例。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 10^6 pairs/s and total efficiency 0.10 per arm. Ideal true coincidences are 10^4/s. With raw coincidences 11000/s and accidentals 1000/s, raw CAR=11 and net CAR=10; state the convention.
workedExample.assumptions: 低多對、獨立損失及無死時間近似；未包含濾波純度與偵測飽和。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Low multipair, independent-loss and negligible-dead-time assumptions; filtering purity and detector saturation are excluded.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.summary: 從晶圓位置、耦合去嵌入與量測統計拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate wafer position, coupling de-embedding and measurement statistics, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設同型耦合器的 1 cm 與 3 cm 波導總損耗分別為 5.2 與 6.0 dB：α=(6.0−5.2)/(3−1)=0.40 dB/cm；共同截距=4.8 dB。若兩次獨立量測的標準不確定度各 0.10 dB，u(α)=√2×0.10/2=0.071 dB/cm，未含長度或耦合器變異。
workedExample.textEn: Assume matched-coupler waveguides of 1 and 3 cm have 5.2 and 6.0 dB total loss. α=(6.0−5.2)/(3−1)=0.40 dB/cm and intercept=4.8 dB. Two independent 0.10 dB standard uncertainties give u(α)=0.071 dB/cm, excluding length and coupler variation.
workedExample.assumptions: 假設同波長、同偏振、同耦合器及線性長度模型；真實製程需多長度及重複樣本。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Assume matched wavelength, polarization and couplers with linear length dependence; real processes need multiple lengths and repeats.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

quiz.question: 要審查「切回法斜率」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing cutback slope?
options: 未測晶粒應自動算通過。
單張外觀照片可以量得傳播損耗。
重算教學算例，再以重複結構估計耦合器散布與斜率信賴區間。
optionsEn: Untested dies automatically count as passes.
One exterior photograph measures propagation loss.
Recalculate the example and use repeated structures to estimate coupler scatter and a slope confidence interval.
quiz.explanation: 同型耦合器與不同波導長度可分離長度相關損耗和共同截距；耦合器差異會污染斜率。 重算教學算例，再以重複結構估計耦合器散布與斜率信賴區間。
quiz.explanationEn: Matched couplers and different lengths separate propagation slope and common intercept; coupler mismatch contaminates the slope. Recalculate the example and use repeated structures to estimate coupler scatter and a slope confidence interval.

steps.title: 對準搜尋：模型與設計

steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for alignment search, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. A best alignment can hide probe instability; production testing needs convergence and repeatability. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Reapproach repeatedly and compare peak power, search iterations and failures. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 多次離開後重新對準，比較峰值、搜尋次數與失敗率。

courses.title: 光子封裝熱機耦合分析
courses.summary: 從熱場、翹曲、界面和光模式的耦合拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate coupled temperature fields, warpage, interfaces and optical modes, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設兩材料 CTE 差 Δα=12×10⁻⁶/K、長度 L=10 mm、溫差 ΔT=50 K，自由失配位移 Δu=ΔαLΔT=6 µm。這不是實際封裝位移或應力；機械拘束、翹曲與材料溫度依賴尚未加入。
workedExample.textEn: Assume Δα=12×10⁻⁶/K, L=10 mm and ΔT=50 K. Free mismatch Δu=ΔαLΔT=6 µm. This is not actual package displacement or stress; constraints, curvature and temperature-dependent properties are omitted.
workedExample.assumptions: 小變形、局部線性近似；不同晶向、塑性與黏彈歷史需另建模型。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Small-deformation/local-linear approximation; crystal orientation, plasticity and viscoelastic history need separate models.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: 光路溫度漂移補償
courses.summary: 從漂移量測、熱串擾與穩定回授拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate drift sensing, thermal crosstalk and stable feedback, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設共振溫度斜率 80 pm/K，環境變化 3 K 產生 240 pm 漂移；假設加熱器斜率 40 pm/mW，要反向補償 240 pm 需相對原偏壓減少 6 mW。若原偏壓僅 4 mW，單純加熱器無法完成此負向補償。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 80 pm/K resonance drift and a 3 K change: 240 pm. With 40 pm/mW heater slope, opposing this shift requires reducing bias by 6 mW. A 4 mW initial bias cannot supply that negative correction.
workedExample.assumptions: 局部線性且固定偏振；這組斜率是假想值，沒有代表特定製程。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Local linearity and fixed polarization; slopes are hypothetical, not a process specification.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: 光子封裝失效重路由
courses.summary: 從N−1 連通、光功率裕度與恢復狀態機拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate N−1 connectivity, optical power margins and restoration state machines, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. workedExample.text: 假想網路兩條路徑 S-A-T 的損耗為 1+1=2 dB；S-B-C-T 為 1.5+1.5+1.5=4.5 dB。若發射 0 dBm、接收門檻 −6 dBm，正常裕度 4 dB、備援裕度 1.5 dB；要求保留 2 dB 時備援雖連通仍不合格。移除共用 S 或 T 則兩路均失效，不能宣稱全節點 N−1。另作容量檢驗：假設兩條互不共用瓶頸的路徑各100 Gb/s，正常共200 Gb/s；失去一條後剩100 Gb/s，若最低服務需150 Gb/s，仍有連通也不合格。
workedExample.textEn: Hypothetical routes S-A-T lose 2 dB and S-B-C-T lose 4.5 dB. With 0 dBm launch and −6 dBm receiver threshold, margins are 4 and 1.5 dB. A 2 dB reserve rejects the connected backup. Removing shared S or T disables both, so full node-N−1 is not achieved. For a separate capacity check, two paths with no shared bottleneck at 100 Gb/s each provide 200 Gb/s normally and 100 Gb/s after either fails; a 150 Gb/s minimum fails despite connectivity.
workedExample.assumptions: 理想無增益線性路由；門檻與損失為教學假設，未包含非線性、相干串音與 FEC。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Ideal linear routes without gain; assumed thresholds/losses exclude nonlinear effects, coherent crosstalk and FEC.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

knowledge.textEn: Use a non-emitting state model to check break-before-make, lock and rollback conditions.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: Margin=Ptx−IL−Prx,min；合格條件包含圖連通、裕度、容量、時序與故障範圍。 理想無增益線性路由；門檻與損失為教學假設，未包含非線性、相干串音與 FEC。
knowledge.textEn: Margin=Ptx−IL−Prx,min; acceptance combines connectivity, margin, capacity, timing and fault scope. Ideal linear routes without gain; assumed thresholds/losses exclude nonlinear effects, coherent crosstalk and FEC.

quiz.question: 要審查「切換過渡」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing switching transients?
options: 兩路不共邊就沒有任何共同原因失效。
N−1 自動保證任何兩個同時故障。
穩態路由有效不代表切換時不會短暫串音或中斷。
optionsEn: Edge-disjoint routes eliminate all common causes.
N−1 guarantees arbitrary simultaneous double faults.
Valid steady routes do not guarantee interruption- or crosstalk-free transitions.
quiz.explanation: 穩態路由有效不代表切換時不會短暫串音或中斷。 以無實光的狀態模型檢查先斷後接、鎖定與回復條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Valid steady routes do not guarantee interruption- or crosstalk-free transitions. Use a non-emitting state model to check break-before-make, lock and rollback conditions.

steps.title: 切換過渡：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「切換過渡」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for switching transients, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。以無實光的狀態模型檢查先斷後接、鎖定與回復條件。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「穩態路由有效不代表切換時不會短暫串音或中斷。」與錯誤假說「N−1 自動保證任何兩個同時故障。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Use a non-emitting state model to check break-before-make, lock and rollback conditions. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Valid steady routes do not guarantee interruption- or crosstalk-free transitions." against the incorrect hypothesis "N−1 guarantees arbitrary simultaneous double faults."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 以無實光的狀態模型檢查先斷後接、鎖定與回復條件。
steps.observationEn: Use a non-emitting state model to check break-before-make, lock and rollback conditions.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：N−1 自動保證任何兩個同時故障。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: N−1 guarantees arbitrary simultaneous double faults. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交切換過渡的量測判別表：以無實光的狀態模型檢查先斷後接、鎖定與回復條件。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for switching transients: Use a non-emitting state model to check break-before-make, lock and rollback conditions. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

courses.title: 封裝應力對光學相位的影響
courses.summary: 從晶向、應變張量、模態重疊與光程拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate crystal axes, strain tensors, modal overlap and optical path, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 λ=1.55 µm、L=1 mm、neff=2.4、Δneff=1×10⁻⁵、軸向應變 ε=10 µstrain=10⁻⁵，則 ΔL=10 nm；材料項 Δφn=0.0405 rad，長度項 ΔφL=0.0973 rad，总計 0.1378 rad。Δneff 是假設的有效模態變化，不是引用矽的固定塊材係數。
workedExample.textEn: Assume λ=1.55 µm, L=1 mm, neff=2.4, Δneff=10⁻⁵ and axial strain ε=10 µstrain=10⁻⁵, giving ΔL=10 nm. The index term is 0.0405 rad and length term 0.0973 rad, totaling 0.1378 rad. Δneff is an assumed modal change, not a fixed bulk-silicon coefficient.
workedExample.assumptions: 小擾動且真空波長固定；張量、偏振、材料色散和幾何重算需在完整模型中處理。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Small perturbations at fixed vacuum wavelength; full models treat tensors, polarization, dispersion and deformed geometry.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

courses.title: 光子晶片製程設計套件
courses.summary: 從PDK 版本、設計規則、模型角落與封裝交接拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate PDK versions, design rules, model corners and assembly handoff, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設路徑有兩耦合器各 1.5 dB、四分光器各 0.2 dB 超額損失及 2 cm 波導 α=0.5 dB/cm，總額外損失=3+0.8+1=4.8 dB。若波導角落 α=0.8，其他固定，為 5.4 dB；6 dB 額外損耗預算的裕度由 1.2 變成 0.6 dB。理想分光到特定支路的功率分配損失須另加，不能漏算。
workedExample.textEn: Assume two 1.5 dB couplers, four 0.2 dB splitter excess losses and 2 cm at 0.5 dB/cm: extra loss is 4.8 dB. At 0.8 dB/cm it becomes 5.4 dB, reducing a 6 dB excess-loss budget margin from 1.2 to 0.6 dB. Ideal splitting to the selected branch must be added separately.
workedExample.assumptions: 假想元件庫和損失，非任一 PDK 規格；不分發受限制 PDK。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Hypothetical library/losses, not a PDK specification; restricted PDKs are not redistributed.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。比較新舊結果及差異來源，保留可重現的測試案例與批准記錄。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「修正模型或元件後須回歸測試，舊模擬結果不能自動沿用。」與錯誤假說「DRC 通過就保證光學功能合格。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Compare revisions and causes of differences, retaining reproducible tests and approval records. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Model/cell changes require regression; old simulation results cannot be assumed valid." against the incorrect hypothesis "Passing DRC guarantees optical function."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 比較新舊結果及差異來源，保留可重現的測試案例與批准記錄。
steps.observationEn: Compare revisions and causes of differences, retaining reproducible tests and approval records.

steps.check: 提交變更回歸的量測判別表：比較新舊結果及差異來源，保留可重現的測試案例與批准記錄。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for change regression: Compare revisions and causes of differences, retaining reproducible tests and approval records. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

courses.title: 共封裝光學交換器整合
courses.summary: 從交換 ASIC、光引擎、雷射與散熱的共同介面拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate joint switch-ASIC, optical-engine, laser and cooling interfaces, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想系統有 ASIC 600 W、8 個光引擎每個 15 W、外接雷射 40 W、控制 10 W，系統合計 770 W。若8個引擎每個單向 1.6 Tb/s，單向總量 12.8 Tb/s；770/12.8×10¹²=60.2 pJ/bit 是此系統邊界的平均能量，不能稱為光子晶片本身能效。
workedExample.textEn: A hypothetical system has a 600 W ASIC, eight 15 W engines, 40 W external lasers and 10 W control: 770 W. Eight 1.6 Tb/s one-way engines total 12.8 Tb/s. 770/(12.8×10¹²)=60.2 pJ/bit is system-boundary energy, not intrinsic photonic-chip efficiency.
workedExample.assumptions: 固定滿載、未加備援與冷卻設施功耗；教學數字不代表任何商用 CPO。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Fixed full load excludes spare capacity and facility cooling; values do not describe a commercial CPO product.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

quiz.question: 要審查「雷射配置」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing laser placement?
options: 光引擎靠近 ASIC 就不再需要熱設計。
任一光協議符合就代表全部機械和管理互通。
外接與內置雷射在光分配、維修及熱環境上有不同折衷。
optionsEn: Optics near an ASIC no longer need thermal design.
One optical agreement proves mechanical and management interoperability.
External and integrated lasers trade distribution, service and thermal conditions.
quiz.explanation: 外接與內置雷射在光分配、維修及熱環境上有不同折衷。 在同一接收功率要求下比較總電功耗、連接損失及故障域。

steps.title: 雷射配置：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「雷射配置」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for laser placement, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。在同一接收功率要求下比較總電功耗、連接損失及故障域。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「外接與內置雷射在光分配、維修及熱環境上有不同折衷。」與錯誤假說「任一光協議符合就代表全部機械和管理互通。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Compare electrical power, connection losses and fault domains at equal received power. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "External and integrated lasers trade distribution, service and thermal conditions." against the incorrect hypothesis "One optical agreement proves mechanical and management interoperability."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 在同一接收功率要求下比較總電功耗、連接損失及故障域。

steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: One optical agreement proves mechanical and management interoperability. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交雷射配置的量測判別表：在同一接收功率要求下比較總電功耗、連接損失及故障域。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for laser placement: Compare electrical power, connection losses and fault domains at equal received power. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for joint testing, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.

steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for joint testing, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. A standalone optical-engine pass does not prove timing/noise after co-packaging. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Use matched pre/post-package tests with simultaneous ASIC switching. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 設計封裝前後相同參考面測試，加入 ASIC 同時切換負載。
steps.observationEn: Use matched pre/post-package tests with simultaneous ASIC switching.

courses.title: 光學輸入輸出小晶片
courses.summary: 從通道、光波長、能量及端到端可用容量拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate lanes, optical wavelengths, energy and end-to-end usable capacity, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設每方向 64 通道、每通道 32 Gb/s，則單向=2.048 Tb/s，雙向合計=4.096 Tb/s。若有效負載比例 0.90，單向有效=1.8432 Tb/s。另假設完整光 I/O 功耗 10 W，按單向有效容量計為 5.43 pJ/bit；若改用雙向分母，必須也定義同時雙向負載。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 64 lanes per direction at 32 Gb/s: 2.048 Tb/s one way and 4.096 Tb/s aggregate. At 90% payload, one-way useful capacity is 1.8432 Tb/s. A hypothetical 10 W complete optical-I/O budget gives 5.43 pJ/bit on that denominator; bidirectional accounting must specify simultaneous traffic.
workedExample.assumptions: 通道參數是教學設計，並非複製某晶片所有規格；BER 近似假設獨立稀少錯誤。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Lane inputs are educational, not a complete device specification; BER approximation assumes rare independent errors.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

A hypothetical 10 W complete optical-I/O budget gives 5.43 pJ/bit on that denominator; bidirectional accounting must specify simultaneous traffic.

courses.title: 光子與電子晶片共同設計
courses.summary: 從驅動器、調變器、光偵測器和 TIA 的共同負載拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate joint driver, modulator, photodetector and TIA loading, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
courses.scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
courses.scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 lumped 驅動器 R=50 Ω、PIC及封裝總電容 C=100 fF，fRC=1/(2πRC)=31.8 GHz。若接點再加 50 fF，變成 21.2 GHz。這只是一階電 RC，不代表完整電光 3 dB 頻寬；電極分布、光子壽命和接收器尚未加入。
workedExample.textEn: Assume a lumped 50 Ω driver and 100 fF total load: fRC=31.8 GHz. Another 50 fF lowers it to 21.2 GHz. This is only a first-order electrical RC limit, not complete electro-optic bandwidth; electrode distribution, photon lifetime and receiver are excluded.
workedExample.assumptions: 小訊號線性模型、固定偏壓與端接；需用非線性時域資料驗證大訊號。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Small-signal linear model at fixed bias/termination; large signals need nonlinear time-domain validation.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

steps.objective: 以「擺幅與線性」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for swing and linearity, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。比較相同平均光功率下的 OMA、眼閉合與電功耗。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「高電壓可增加消光但也改變功耗、損耗和非線性，存在多目標折衷。」與錯誤假說「光輸出會讓電返回路徑不再重要。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Compare OMA, eye closure and electrical power at equal average optical power. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Higher swing can improve extinction but changes power, loss and nonlinearity." against the incorrect hypothesis "An optical output removes the need for electrical return paths."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 比較相同平均光功率下的 OMA、眼閉合與電功耗。
steps.observationEn: Compare OMA, eye closure and electrical power at equal average optical power.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：光輸出會讓電返回路徑不再重要。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: An optical output removes the need for electrical return paths. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交擺幅與線性的量測判別表：比較相同平均光功率下的 OMA、眼閉合與電功耗。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for swing and linearity: Compare OMA, eye closure and electrical power at equal average optical power. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

knowledge.title: 本單元物理機制
knowledge.text: 高電壓可增加消光但也改變功耗、損耗和非線性，存在多目標折衷。
knowledge.textEn: Higher swing can improve extinction but changes power, loss and nonlinearity.

knowledge.textEn: Compare OMA, eye closure and electrical power at equal average optical power.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: fRC=1/(2πRC)；Iphoto=responsivity×Popt；串接響應 Htotal=∏Hi。 小訊號線性模型、固定偏壓與端接；需用非線性時域資料驗證大訊號。
knowledge.textEn: fRC=1/(2πRC); Iphoto=responsivity×Popt; cascaded response Htotal=∏Hi. Small-signal linear model at fixed bias/termination; large signals need nonlinear time-domain validation.

quiz.question: 要審查「擺幅與線性」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing swing and linearity?
options: 同一單點雜訊密度保證相同總雜訊。
比較相同平均光功率下的 OMA、眼閉合與電功耗。
光輸出會讓電返回路徑不再重要。
optionsEn: Equal single-point noise density guarantees equal total noise.
Compare OMA, eye closure and electrical power at equal average optical power.
An optical output removes the need for electrical return paths.
quiz.explanation: 高電壓可增加消光但也改變功耗、損耗和非線性，存在多目標折衷。 比較相同平均光功率下的 OMA、眼閉合與電功耗。

List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.

stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units examine returns and thermal coupling, each delivering a model and independent diagnostic evidence.

steps.title: 返回電流：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「返回電流」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for return current, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「返回電流」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。高速光電前端仍須連續接地與返回路徑，光輸出不能消除電共模。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「畫出訊號與返回電流環路，加入封裝接地電感。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for return current, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. High-speed optoelectronics still need continuous return paths; optical output does not eliminate electrical common mode. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Draw signal/return loops and include package-ground inductance. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.

quiz.question: 要審查「熱共同作用」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing thermal interaction?

optionsEn: Total link bandwidth always equals the slowest rated component.
An optical output removes the need for electrical return paths.
Alternate fixed electrical load and optical bias to identify two-way coupling.

stages.title: 共同模型與回歸
stages.description: 以三個技術單元檢查「共同模型與回歸」，每一單元交付設計模型及獨立判別證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units examine shared models and regression, each delivering a model and independent diagnostic evidence.

steps.title: 模型一致性：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「模型一致性」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for model consistency, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「模型一致性」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。電模型和光模型可能使用不同功率、電壓或端接定義，表面相容仍可能錯算。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「用簡單校準激勵核對單位、峰值/RMS 和差動/單端定義。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for model consistency, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Electrical/optical models may use different power, voltage or termination conventions. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Use a calibration stimulus to audit units, peak/RMS and differential/single-ended conventions. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 用簡單校準激勵核對單位、峰值/RMS 和差動/單端定義。

steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：總鏈路頻寬永遠等於最慢元件的標稱頻寬。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Total link bandwidth always equals the slowest rated component. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交模型一致性的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「用簡單校準激勵核對單位、峰值/RMS 和差動/單端定義。」反駁模型的預測。

Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Electrical/optical models may use different power, voltage or termination conventions." against the incorrect hypothesis "An optical output removes the need for electrical return paths."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
